name: RAMSSOL
recent: Ramssol 于 2026 年 11 月 23 日宣布拟以 RM35 million 收购泰国软件公司 GeekStart 剩余 48.997% 股权，其中约 RM20.04 million 以现金支付，另发行 21,000,000 股新股（每股 RM0.7125）。公司 2026 财年第三季净利按年增长 25%，主要来自 Innio Group 收购与 AiTech 增长。近期亦有多笔凭单转换为新股，以及大股东 Urusharta Jamaah 和董事 Datuk Wira Tan Chee Seng 的股权变动申报。
notable: 拟以 RM35 million 收购 GeekStart 剩余 48.997% 股权，完成后 GeekStart 将成为 99.997% 间接子公司。
2026 财年第三季净利按年增长 25%，受 Innio Group 收购与 AiTech 增长带动。
多笔 Warrants-A 行使并发行新股，涉及 50,000 至 500,000 股不等。
risks: 拟发行 21,000,000 股新股作为收购对价的一部分，可能摊薄现有股东持股。
大股东 Urusharta Jamaah Sdn Bhd 及董事 Datuk Wira Tan Chee Seng 近期有多笔股权变动申报。
董事在闭门期前申报拟进行交易。
earnings: 2026 财年第三季（截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日）营收为 RM27.28 million，按年增长 50.6%，按季增长 22.9%；净利为 RM7.429 million，按年增长 27.2%，按季增长 14.3%；净利率为 27.2%，低于上一季的 29.3%。

recent_en: On 23 November 2026, Ramssol proposed to acquire the remaining 48.997% stake in Thai software firm GeekStart for RM35 million, to be satisfied via approximately RM20.04 million cash and 21,000,000 new shares at RM0.7125 each. Q3 FY2026 net profit rose 25% year-on-year, driven by the Innio Group acquisition and AiTech growth. There were also several warrant conversions into new shares and changes in substantial shareholder Urusharta Jamaah and director Datuk Wira Tan Chee Seng's interests.
notable_en: Proposed acquisition of the remaining 48.997% stake in GeekStart for RM35 million; upon completion, GeekStart will become a 99.997% indirect subsidiary.
Q3 FY2026 net profit rose 25% year-on-year, driven by the Innio Group acquisition and AiTech growth.
Several exercises of Warrants-A and issuance of new shares, ranging from 50,000 to 500,000 shares.
risks_en: Proposed issuance of 21,000,000 new shares as part of the acquisition consideration may dilute existing shareholders.
Substantial shareholder Urusharta Jamaah Sdn Bhd and director Datuk Wira Tan Chee Seng have made multiple recent interest change filings.
A director declared intention to deal during the closed period.
earnings_en: For Q3 FY2026 (ended 30 June 2026), revenue was RM27.28 million, up 50.6% year-on-year and 22.9% quarter-on-quarter; net profit was RM7.429 million, up 27.2% year-on-year and 14.3% quarter-on-quarter; net margin was 27.2%, down from 29.3% in the previous quarter.
